_comment: Per-page action plan, keyed by slug. build_migration_dashboard.py and the 22d-trello app load it and attach it to the page. To add a new page plan, add a key with its slug. WEBFLOW-FIRST: the 'sections' are the Shimma template sections in Webflow (the build guide); each maps the SOTSI content that goes there and where it comes from in WordPress. English content.

home.base: Webflow template (Shimma) — https://seat-of-the-soul-institute-21f797.webflow.io/  · The template is the GUIDE; we map SOTSI content onto each section Webflow already offers.
home.template: Shimma (wellness). Today only the Courses Offerings cards are customized with real SOTSI programs; everything else is still demo.
home.hours_note: Per-section hours re-estimated for template adaptation (not from scratch). Total ≈ 46.5h (was 42h). Role split: Design 8.5 · Content 10.5 · Media 11 · Build 8.5 · Review 8.

ai_context.verdict: BUILD on the 11 Shimma template sections; replace demo with SOTSI content section by section.
ai_context.summary: The Webflow Home already has a solid 11-section skeleton (video hero, about split, programs row, first-visit band, 3 benefits, team grid, events with calendar, testimonials, latest posts, marquee CTA band, footer). TODAY only the Programs row (Courses) is customized with 3 real SOTSI programs (Authentic Power Guidelines, Beyond the Five Senses, Soul Themes); everything else is still Shimma demo (hero 'Harmony', team 'Aria Thompson', fake testimonials & blog, 'Shimma' footer). The Home job is to fill each template section with the right SOTSI content (taken from the old WordPress Home + brand), not to redesign the structure.
recommendations: Use the template order as the fixed guide: hero → about → programs → first-visit → 3 benefits → team → events → testimonials → blog → marquee CTA → footer.

Hero: swap the 'Harmony' video and the '→ /products' CTA for a real mountain/water video (SOTSI brand rule, never AI), the message 'Spiritual Growth & Emotional Awareness with Gary Zukav', and a Get Started CTA.
Programs (Courses): already has 3 real ones; decide whether to expand to the 4 pillars (Authentic Power, Emotional Awareness, Responsible Choice, Spiritual Partnership).
Team: turn the demo grid into the Founders (Gary & Linda) with real photos — Linda is sensitive content (memorial, client sign-off).

Mandatory global cleanup: SOTSI logo (not Shimma), remove the 'Get Template'/Flowzai promo bar, the 'Shimma…' SEO titles, real social, and decide on the e-commerce cart (active today, hero points to /products).
Testimonials and Blog are new vs the old Home — testimonials need real approved quotes; the blog is filled in Phase 2 (167 keep).

global_components: Navbar with menu (Home/About/Classes/Teams/Events/Blog/Products/Contact) + pages dropdown + 'Get Template' CTA + active e-commerce CART → rewrite links to SOTSI, own logo, remove 'Get Template', decide cart.
Marquee CTA band 'Start Your Journey' (→ book a class) repeated above the footer on every page → reuse as SOTSI community/newsletter CTA.
Multi-column footer (Quick Links + Utilities) + newsletter + social + 'Shimma | Flowzai' copyright → reuse; strip Shimma/Flowzai branding and placeholder social.
template_analysis.tokens: Shimma ships warm (Playfair + Montserrat on cream/sand/espresso, pill buttons). Central re-skin to SOTSI: navy/purple + Canela/Jost. Change variables, not per component.
strip_or_fix: E-commerce cart + Checkout/PayPal/SKU pages if commerce isn't decided (hero 'Get Started' currently goes to /products).
'Unlock 250+ Templates' promo bar + 'Get Template' CTA + 'Designed by Flowzai' credit.
Shimma logo → SOTSI logo; 'Shimma - Webflow Ecommerce Website Template' SEO titles on every page.
Demo content: team (Aria Thompson…), testimonials, About, Events and the fake blog posts.
Broken link: the first-visit band 'View beginner guide' points to /team.
